The first call passes the builder pointer stored at this[0] + 28 and the second the one at this[0] + 44. Returns 1 on success and 0 when the dimension guard fails.

Return 0 when either dimension guard fails.
Call CollisionBroadphaseBuilder with the first builder pointer located at this[0] + 28 (reading the object pointer at offset 0, then advancing 28 bytes), plus a2, a3, a4, a5.
Call CollisionBroadphaseBuilder with the second builder pointer located at this[0] + 44, plus a2, a3, a4, a5.
Return 1 after both CollisionBroadphaseBuilder calls complete.
